title: Final numerical answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the minimum horizontal speed relative to ground as approximately 2.9 m/s.

title: Initial momentum setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly calculate the initial total momentum of the system before the jump, accounting for both carts and the person moving in opposite directions.

title: Momentum conservation for jump
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply momentum conservation separately for the jump from cart A and the landing on cart B, with correct mass assignments.

title: No-collision condition
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly state the kinematic condition (v₁ ≥ v₂) required to prevent the carts from colliding after the transfer.

title: Algebraic solving
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should show clear algebraic manipulation to solve for the unknown person's speed from the system of equations.

title: Sign error in momentum
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the solution uses incorrect signs for the velocities of the oppositely moving carts in the momentum equations.

title: Relative vs. ground speed
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the solution confuses the person's speed relative to the ground with speed relative to a cart, or fails to specify the reference frame for the answer.
